notes.title: RAT MEMORY update 1.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi, as you may know, RAT MEMORY exited early access in the end of January. This is the first major patch, RAT MEMORY 1.1., and brings the following:

New content:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Level selection: After completing the game, you can choose a level to play again. This is useful to get missing achievements, find secrets or speedrun the game;
[*] Added an achievement for collecting all coins in night 4 level.
[*] Added a new camera angle in main menu.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Character doesn’t move anymore by pressing the “move backward” button in 2d levels to prevent a bug;
[*] Fixed a bug with brick walls when quick-restarting a level.
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed specific actions from the “default controls” section in some levels;
[*] Edited credits screen.
[/list]

Please leave a review on Steam, and share the game to your friends! It helps the game.

notes.title: RAT MEMORY Full release delay
notes.notes:
Hi, today I bring some info on RAT MEMORY full game release.
Unfortunately, due to some last-minute bugs related to the new content, the full game won't be releasing in January 23.

Instead, hopefully it will come in January 27. I hope that with this extra time I can add all the content planned, polish the game and finish the development while also adding Steam Achievements if possible.

Please follow Quero Games on [url=https://twitter.com/querogames]X[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/querogames.bsky.social]Blue Sky[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfMzFdiw4-dfsLe3gkWiVTQ/]Youtube[/url].

notes.title: RAT MEMORY update 0.9.7
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi, this is a patch that brings the following to RAT MEMORY Early Access version 0.9.7:
New content and changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a total time played screen when finishing a level. Now you can make a page for RAT MEMORY on howlongtobeat.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some lines appearing on cardboards.
[*] Now you can finish day levels early if you have enough coins (probably).
[*] Fixed some bugs that prevented the progression of the game.
[*] Fixed respawn trigger in level 9.
[*] Finally I totally fixed cardboard not resetting when restarting the level. ([strike][i]please[/i][/strike])
[/list]

As all quality of life features and most important bug fixes are now implemented in the game, I'm working in the final version - the full game - so the next updates should come less often, with just small content updates and/or bug fixes as I'm now adding a new important collectible and the other things related to the story mode.

notes.title: Be the fastest in the new update and win the full game!
notes.notes:
RAT MEMORY DEMO got a new update, that you can see [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1953100/view/3345626054776594241]here[/url].

[b][h2]Playing the demo you have the chance to win the full game on the release date![/h2][/b]

[h3][b]How to win:[/b][/h3]

Send me a screenshot of your fastest demo completion time via steam or [url=https://twitter.com/QueroGames]Twitter[/url].

You can just finish the second level, collecting just the required coins, or collect all coins.

The fastest time in each category will get a key of the full game on the release date (currently early 2023). [i]Previous winners won't earn the prize again.[/i]

[b]Good luck![/b]

notes.title: Demo update 2.0 September 6 2022
notes.notes:
[i]First of all, sorry for the delay. I promised this update would be available in late August, but a critical bug prevented me to launch it. Now that the bug is fixed, I can publish it. Have fun![/i]

This update for RAT MEMORY DEMO brings many improvements and some content!

[b]NEW:[/b]
[h2]A new level![/h2]
This is a exploration level - find the coins in this not so colorful level to unlock the star.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42467984/9d5722e3df0fae1bbe713de33bc88e8601ad03cd.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added level selection menu in main menu.
[*] Added button to reset camera view.
[*] Added full gamepad support to menus.
[*] You can close menus with your pause button.
[*] Added some settings, like sensitivity of camera, ability to invert the camera controls, gamma correction and audio volume.
[*] Added checkpoints in old level.
[*] Added Quero Games logo in credits.
[/list]

[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*] I changed the jump slightly - you should be able to reach the same height, but maybe at a lower speed [i]Thanks for the feedback people![/i].
[*] The change above also fix the character staying forever in air when stuck in a border.
[*] Moved easter-egg in old level to a better position.
[*] Moved player starting point in old level to a better position.
[*] Changed color of default controls screen.
[*] Game size is lower - about 600 MB instead of 1.94GB.
[/list]

[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Camera has a different position. [i]Thanks for the feedback people![/i]
[*] Changed some visuals in old level. [i]Thanks for the feedback people![/i]
[*] Fix for a bug pressing ESC in main menu.
[/list]

[i]Please note that some texts aren't translated in all languages, and I'm sorry for this.[/i]

You can win the full game by playing this level! Details [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1953100/view/3328744607317009389]here[/url]

Follow Quero Games on [url=https://twitter.com/querogames]Twitter[/url] for more updates and news.
